thread:
acme_ops: Hey team — we noticed a bunch of archived embeddings for tenant acme-corp were deleted earlier than their SLA. We expect 90d custom retention but ~30d records vanished. Any idea?

jordan_support: @acme_ops sorry to hear that — can you share the workspace/tenant id and an example object id? Did you see any API errors or deletion webhook calls? :eyes:

acme_ops: tenant: acme-corp-42, example id: emb_8f3a2c. No delete API calls from our side. We only saw a spike in 2024-06-11 03:12 UTC where embeddings ingestion slowed.

lee_eng: @jordan_support tagging infra — could this be a retention-config rollback or migration job? Any config diffs for that tenant?

oncall-bot: deploy-bot posted: "deploy finished: retention-service v3.6.0 -> v3.6.1 at 2024-06-11T03:10:12Z"

jordan_support: That timing matches. @ana_security can you check audit logs around 2024-06-11 03:00-03:30 UTC for policy changes or manual overrides? Also @acme_ops can you paste a redacted API request you use for creating embeddings?

acme_ops: here's our create call (redacted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
{ "model": "open-embed-512", "input": "...", "metadata": {"retention_days": 90} }
```
We set metadata.retention_days on ingest. We saw it honored for earlier objects.

ana_security: FYI I pulled audit events — there is an ACL update at 2024-06-11T03:11:05Z that flipped tenant retention to the org default (30d) for acme-corp-42. Actor: retention-migration-job@internal. Event id: audit_20240611_031105. No manual user actor.

acme_ops: retention-migration-job? We never opted into migrations. Is that expected for Dedicated -> Hosted rollover? This is a customer-impacting change.

lee_eng: Looking at the deploy notes for v3.6.1 — there was a migration to normalize per-tenant retention into a new storage tier. A rollback guard should have skipped tenants with explicit per-object metadata, but the guard might have failed. I'm opening a repro locally.

jordan_support: For the customer timeline: can you confirm how many objects were affected and whether deleted items are recoverable from backups? We need to give acme an ETA.

ana_security: On backups: long-term cold snapshots exist but require KMS unwrap for the tenant key. I see KMS key rotation for acme-corp-42 around 2024-05-30 that switched key version from v1 -> v2. We need HSM team to confirm access to the wrapped keys before restore.

acme_ops: Ugh — KMS rotation was part of our maintenance window but we expected seamless access. If keys are unavailable, restore will be delayed.

lee_eng: Quick repro steps I'm running: 1) deploy v3.6.1 locally 2) create per-object retention via metadata 3) run migration job with guard toggled off 4) check deletion queue. I'll paste logs if I reproduce.

jordan_support: Thanks. I'll escalate to security and infra. Tentative next steps for acme: (a) we will pause any further migration jobs for your tenant, (b) begin recovery planning and KMS key validation with you, (c) provide a deletion audit and list of affected object ids. ETA initial update: 4 hours.

ana_security: Also logged a critical incident: INC-20240611-01 — reason: unexpected retention normalization. Linking to legal/compliance for notification.

acme_ops: Appreciate the fast response. Please include whether retention defaults can be overridden globally while we wait. Also confirm there won't be billing impact for re-ingested objects.

jordan_support: We'll confirm both. For now, please avoid re-ingesting duplicates until we confirm restore options to prevent extra billing. :lock:

lee_eng: Repro update 03:45Z — I can reproduce deletion when migration guard flag is false; guard check failed because per-object metadata was stored under metadata.retention_days but migration expected top-level retention_days. Looks like parsing regression in 3.6.1. Patch incoming.

ana_security: HSM/KMS update: keys are accessible but rotation added an extra wrapping layer. We have a plan to unwrap in secure window; need a written consent from acme to perform restore using their tenant key.

acme_ops: Consent: I confirm acme-corp-42 ops approves unwrapping for restore under our legal controls. Please send consent form and scoping for signature.

jordan_support: Copy — we'll send the consent form and schedule a restore window. Final note: we'll produce an audit export (CSV) showing all policy changes and deletion events for your review. Will follow up in this thread. :white_check_mark:
